title: Elephant calf left alone after mother's death at coffee estate
summary: An elephant calf was found refusing to leave its deceased mother at a coffee estate in Kodagu, Karnataka. The incident occurred on Tuesday. The calf was spotted by locals and conservationists. Authorities are investigating the cause of the mother's death. The calf is being cared for by wildlife officials.
summary_points: An elephant calf was found refusing to leave its deceased mother at a coffee estate in Kodagu, Karnataka
Locals and conservationists spotted the calf
Authorities are investigating the cause of the mother's death

summary_hi: कोडागु कॉफी स्टेशन पर माँ की मृत्यु के बाद बच्चा अपनी माँ को छोड़ने नहीं देता| इस घटना में तuesday को हुआ था। लोगों और संरक्षणकर्ताओं ने बच्चे को देखा। प्राधिकरण यह जांच कर रहे हैं कि माँ की मृत्यु का कारण क्या था।

center: Centrist coverage highlighted the emotional toll on the calf, focusing on its refusal to leave its mother's side.
बच्चे की माँ के पास रहने के लिए इसका भावनात्मक प्रभाव पर जोर दिया गया, बच्चे को अपनी माँ के पास छोड़ने से इनकार करना।
